<description>
Doxygen attaches a comment block that lacks a `@file` command to the next declaration rather than to the file.

For example:

This PR fixes that.

Requested in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36805#discussion_r4511737767:
[quoted text omitted]

Required for https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36805.
</description>

<commits>
c7ebbbba6c doc: Fix Doxygen attribution of file-level comments

Without an explicit @file command, Doxygen attached these comments to
the next declaration.

4cb432772c doc: Fix `@file` descriptions that start with the file name

Doxygen treats the word after `@file` as the name of the documented
file and drops it from the text. Use a bare `@file` and `@brief`
instead.

Co-Authored-By: fanquake <fanquake@gmail.com>

c4a68cc5ce doc: Attach `subprocess.h` header comment to the file

Add `@file` and `@brief` so Doxygen documents the file rather than the
`subprocess_close` macro.

Also move the whole comment block inside the include guard. This
simplifies upcoming changes to the include guard linter.
</commits>
